company.name: Tenyks
company.shortDescription: Tenyks helps AI developers build reliable vision systems.
company.description:
Tenyks is a University of Cambridge spin-out inventing the way humanity interacts with AI to protect the world from the terminator. Our MLOps monitoring and validation platform helps ML Engineers working with computer vision data to build more reliable software faster. Specifically, our platform helps ML Engineers understand what's wrong with their algorithms and fix issues. 
Our technology is based on 2 PhD and 1 Master theses in Explainable AI from the University of Cambridge.
